title: Summer Makers Market
excerpt: Local makers, small-batch producers and one-of-a-kind finds fill the mall for a day.
body: Stalls from local makers and small producers join our resident independents for one day only — think prints, ceramics, preserves, candles and more.
Entry is free and the market runs right through the centre, so you can browse the stalls and the stores in one easy loop.

title: Half-Term Craft Mornings
excerpt: Free drop-in craft sessions for little hands during October half term.
body: Bring the kids along for free drop-in craft sessions in the mall — seasonal makes, friendly helpers and everything provided.
Sessions are drop-in, no booking needed. Children must be accompanied by an adult.

title: Christmas Lights Switch-On
excerpt: The moment the Guildbourne starts to sparkle — join us as the centre lights up for the season.
body: Join us as the centre's festive lights go on for the season, with late browsing at participating stores and a few sweet surprises for the little ones.

title: Spring Charity Fair
excerpt: A day of stalls and fundraising in support of local causes, including the Brent Lodge wildlife hospital.
body: Local charities and community groups took over the mall for a day of stalls, tombolas and fundraising — with our own Brent Lodge shop flying the flag for the wildlife hospital.
